findings.title: Task 5 rewrites store.ts from the prototype base and drops the sector HUD slice master added
findings.claim: Task 5 Step 3 replaces all of `ui/store.ts` with a version whose initial state is `duel: null, flight: null, latency: null, epochs: { duel: 0, flight: 0 }, crt: DEFAULT_CRT`. On the branch, `createUiStore` also sets `hud: null` and `epochs: { duel: 0, flight: 0, hud: 0 }`, and `UiState` requires both.
findings.evidence: plan L1485-L1508 (L1506: `duel: null, flight: null, latency: null, epochs: { duel: 0, flight: 0 }, crt: DEFAULT_CRT`) vs src/renderer/src/ui/store.ts:L18 (`duel: null, flight: null, hud: null, latency: null, epochs: { duel: 0, flight: 0, hud: 0 }`); menuState.ts:L30 (`hud: import('../render/hudModel').HudModel | null`) and L34 (`epochs: { duel: number; flight: number; hud: number }`); sinks.ts:L19 and L27 (`createHudSink` bumps `s.epochs[key] + 1`); UiRoot.tsx:L12, L17 (reads `s.epochs.hud`); tests/uiSinks.test.ts:L42 (`expect(store.getState().epochs).toEqual({ duel: 0, flight: 0, hud: 0 })`); main.ts:L73 (`createHudSink(store, perf)`).
findings.why: Step 9's `npx tsc -b` fails because `hud` is missing from the state literal and from `epochs`. `uiSinks.test.ts` L42 fails, and Step 9 expects it to pass unchanged. At runtime the sector HUD's epoch becomes NaN, so the HUD region's error-boundary reset key breaks. The executor cannot pass Task 5 as written.
findings.fix: Do not replace the whole file. Use two Edit steps: add `import { DEFAULT_CRT, type CrtSetting } from '../render/crt';`, change L18 to `duel: null, flight: null, hud: null, latency: null, epochs: { duel: 0, flight: 0, hud: 0 }, crt: DEFAULT_CRT`, and append `setCrtSetting`. Check every other 'replace the whole file' step in Tasks 4 and 5 against HEAD the same way (the others match today).

findings.title: Baselines and expected test counts are from fbba4da, before the master merge
findings.claim: Step 0.3 expects 283 files and 4040 tests, and Task 7 Step 1 expects 290 files and 4097 tests. Tasks 1 and 4 expect artGuards at 194 and 198 (from 189). The branch already has more tests: 292 `tests/**/*.test.*` files before this plan. artGuards now generates 4 + 3 + 2×84 render `.ts` files + 28 app `.ts` files = 203 tests. Master added `render/painted/*` (7 files, so 14 tests).
findings.evidence: plan L181, L402 (`Tests 203 passed (203)` … `artGuards 194 (189 before…)`), L1243 (`Tests 231 passed (231)` … `artGuards 198`), L2201 (`Test Files 290 … Tests 4097`), L2452; tests/artGuards.test.ts:L12, L40, L49 (per-file generation); the Glob of src/renderer/src/render/**/*.ts lists 84 files (including painted/blastDraw … tokenDraw) and app/**/*.ts 28; the Glob of tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} gives 292 files.
findings.why: A subagent that follows 'Expected' literally sees different totals at Step 0, Task 1 Step 6, Task 4 Step 7 and Task 7 Step 1. It may stop and report, or it may stop trusting the count check that is meant to catch a missed test.
findings.fix: State counts as deltas from the recorded Step 0 baseline: Task 1 artGuards = baseline + 5; Task 4 artGuards = baseline + 9; Task 7 = baseline + 57 tests in + 7 files; uiBoundary + 2. Alternatively recompute today's absolutes (artGuards 203 → 208 → 212) and drop 'at fbba4da' from Step 0.3.

findings.title: Task 7's 'sim unchanged' and 'theme unchanged' diffs use a base from before the master merge
findings.claim: Task 7 Step 2 runs `git diff fbba4da --stat` over the sim, authority, network, shared and main directories, and over theme.ts, EndCard.tsx and LatencyOverlay.tsx, and expects no output. HEAD now contains merge 869a27e, which brought master's work (art spike, interior zoom, React UI). Any master change to those paths since fbba4da shows up even though this plan changed nothing there.
findings.evidence: plan L2208-L2212 (`git diff fbba4da --stat -- src/renderer/src/sim … src/main`; `git diff fbba4da --stat -- src/renderer/src/render/theme.ts …`); the brief's git log: 869a27e `Merge branch 'master' into crt-map` after 6cb6345.
findings.why: The determinism-boundary check gives a false failure, or trains the executor to ignore output. The check that matters is that the plan's own commits change none of those paths.
findings.fix: Record `BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)` in Step 0.1 (at 3c296ea or later) and diff against `$BASE` in Task 7 Step 2. Alternatively use `git diff $(git merge-base HEAD master)`. Keep the SIM_VERSION = 39 and golden test checks.

findings.title: menuState.ts line anchor is stale
findings.claim: The Task 5 Files list says to modify `src/renderer/src/ui/menuState.ts:416`. The `latency: readonly string[] | null;` field it edits is at line 32. The edit uses the old string, which is unique, so it still applies.
findings.why: A misleading anchor makes the executor search, and it hints that the plan was not re-anchored after the merge.

findings.title: The grid's major lines use `dim`, but the spec says `faint`, and no spec note covers it
findings.claim: Decision 2 maps `GRID` to 'major `dim` at 0.5, minor `faint` at 1'. Spec §2 says 'grid `faint`'. Spec notes 1-6 list the other deviations (lock block `mid`, FeelPanel, frame-time bar) but not this one.
findings.evidence: plan L52 and L1132 (`color: l.major ? CRT.dim : CRT.faint, alpha: l.major ? 0.5 : 1`); spec L27 ('grid `faint`'); plan L2470-L2477 (spec notes, no grid entry).
findings.why: The brief says the plan may deviate from the spec only when it states and justifies the deviation; this one is silent (the change itself is harmless).
findings.fix: Add a spec note: major lines `dim` at 0.5 so that 500-unit squares read apart from the 250-unit minors at `faint` (both still ramp colours). Otherwise draw both in `faint`.
